matches.description: Watch Sparta Rotterdam vs Excelsior highlights and goals from Eredivisie on ReFooty: Football Highlights Hub. Match played on May 17, 2026. On 2026-05-17 , the Eredivisie delivered a high-octane encounter at the Sparta Stadion as Sparta Rotterdam hosted Excelsior . In front of an engaged crowd of 10,599 fans, the match provided a masterclass in emotional swings, featuring early errors, a second-half goal fest, and a climax that left one side celebrating and the other in total disbelief. Early Setback and Tactical Struggle The match began under a cloud of misfortune for the hosts. Just 14 minutes into the contest, Giannino Vianello inadvertently directed the ball into his own net, gifting Excelsior an early lead. Sparta Rotterdam struggled to find their rhythm following the own goal, and their frustrations were further compounded when Vito van Crooij saw yellow late in the first half. Despite holding a slight edge in possession, the home side entered the break trailing, unable to convert their pressure into clear-cut opportunities. A Flurry of Second-Half Action The game exploded into life following the restart. Excelsior doubled their advantage in the 50th minute through Arthur Zagre , who clinical finish looked to have put the visitors in total control. However, Sparta Rotterdam responded almost immediately; Ayoni Santos pulled one back in the 53rd minute to ignite the home support. The momentum swung back toward the visitors shortly after, as Noah Naujoks rose highest to head home a Gyan de Regt cross in the 62nd minute, restoring the two-goal cushion. Late Drama and VAR Intervention As the clock ticked into stoppage time, the atmosphere reached a fever pitch. Milan Zonneveld gave the hosts a lifeline in the 91st minute, finishing coolly after being set up by Tobias Lauritsen . Just moments later, the stadium erupted as Zonneveld appeared to have completed a miraculous comeback with a second goal. However, the celebrations were cut short by a lengthy VAR review. The referee eventually overturned the goal due to a foul in the buildup, leaving Sparta Rotterdam heartbroken. Despite a late effort from Patrick van Aanholt , Excelsior held firm to secure a dramatic victory.

First half momentum Twente looked the sharper side early on, with Daan Rots consistently delivering dangerous corners that tested the visitor's resolve. The intensity reached its peak at the 35th minute when Thomas van den Belt attempted a sensational bicycle kick that rattled the crossbar. Despite Sparta Rotterdam finding pockets of space through Casper Terho , they were unable to beat Joel Drommel , who handled every aerial threat with composure. The teams went into the break with the deadlock unbroken, but the momentum clearly favored the home side. Second half dominance Following the interval, the pressure finally told. Thomas van den Belt broke the deadlock in the 59th minute, tapping home a precise finish following collaborative play from Bart van Rooij and Daan Rots . With the lead secured, Twente pushed forward with renewed confidence. In the 71st minute, Kristian Hlynsson doubled the advantage with a clinical header, and just seven minutes later, Daan Rots added a third with a left-footed strike. The match concluded on a somber note for the visitors, as Alwande Roaldsoey was forced off with an injury, leaving the side with ten men.
